options.prompt:
Create one realistic, production-quality Chinese desktop web app UI design for 海客科技 (Haike Technology), titled 内容优先工作台. Canvas 1440 x 1024, natural desktop viewport, app content only, no browser chrome, no device frame, no montage. This is a serious new UX design for an existing runnable video production app. Current date 2026-10-13. Attached screenshots show the current poor UI to improve; preserve the actual functions and brand, DO NOT replicate their spacing or oversized preview.

Grounding: use the attached actual HAIKE 海客科技 orange-yellow logo, proportionally scaled on white, never invent another logo. Use restrained orange #f64b00 for primary actions, pale warm yellow #fff7c1 for selected navigation, charcoal #191919, muted slate #687180, light separators #e3e5e9, warm off-white #f7f7f5. Body Chinese 14–16px, h1 28px, labels 14px, one clean sans font. Crisp professional components, deliberate 8px spacing system, 24–32px comfortable grouping, 44px input/button height, radius 10px, dark legible button text or white with sufficient contrast. Avoid card-within-card and decorative dashboards; use whitespace and thin dividers.

Keep a stable white left sidebar 242px wide. Compact logo at top followed by 海客视频, no huge marketing block. Exactly these shared menu groups: 创作: 图文视频 (active), 数字人口播; 管理: 我的作品, 发布日历; 设置: API 设置. 账户中心 anchored bottom. Outline icons of consistent size. Selected row rounded pale yellow with a slim orange marker, never a thick black outline. No other menus or features.

Main header 图文视频 with small helper 文字与三个画面，组成一个观点. Recompose the workspace: the main form occupies the left two thirds and a narrower persistent reference preview occupies the right third with a simple vertical divider; no huge stacked title cards. All important controls comfortably visible in this viewport. Only one real graphic template exists: 资讯三景, 9:16 · 9秒, selected in a compact single horizontal selection row with a tiny proportional thumbnail, not a fake template gallery.

The content editor has clearly spaced sections:
视频名称 input 海客科技 · 图文视频.
顶部标题: three short single-line inputs in one row, labeled 第一行 / 第二行 / 第三行, sample values 海客科技 / 让创作更简单 / 图文视频工作流.
结论条 input 三个画面 · 一个观点.
三个画面: three horizontal rows with scene label and time 画面1 0–3秒 / 画面2 3–6秒 / 画面3 6–9秒. Each row has a compact soft dashed upload slot with upload icon and 上传图片 / 视频, and a readable 3-line editable detail textarea alongside it. Sample details choose actual project values: 选择模板\n准备文字与素材\n按三景组织内容; 统一接入\n一个Key调用能力\n成本和明细可查看; 计划发布\n选择成片和账号\n按日历安排时间. Design the upload empty state as calm and actionable, not a large button inside nested cards.
模板排版与音乐 is one collapsed secondary disclosure row for existing font sizes/colors/background music; no feature invention.

Right region labeled 版式参考, metadata 1080 × 1920. A modest proportional 9:16 preview about 218 × 388 pixels uses the attached native graphic composition: dark near-black three-line headline, gold 海客科技, white other lines, gold conclusion bar, navy central image position, dark bottom detail box. Under it concise helper 参考现有排版，生成后使用你的内容. NO fake live-preview claim. Surrounding area stays airy but not excessively empty.

A persistent bottom action bar spans the main workspace with a subtle separator, supporting text 本地合成 · ¥0 and small actionable missing-material text 请上传三个画面. Right-aligned secondary outlined 保存草稿 and one primary orange 生成图文视频, with appropriate disabled treatment while empty. This must visually solve the current buried CTA. Do not show unrelated charts, metrics, filters, pricing plans, model names, avatars, fake user accounts or fake completed videos. This single screen should feel polished, humane, immediately usable, focused on actual work.

Create ONE independent production-quality Chinese desktop app UI concept called 预览伴随编辑 for the existing 海客科技 video workbench. 1440 x 1024 natural desktop app viewport; no browser/OS frame; no montage, no device shell. Current date 2026-10-13. The attached screenshots are the current UI whose excessive preview, crowded fields and buried buttons must be redesigned, not copied. Use actual attached HAIKE 海客科技 logo accurately.

Keep real brand: restrained bright orange #f64b00 actions, warm pale yellow #fff7c1 selection, charcoal black Chinese text, subtle warm gray page #f7f7f5, white editing surface. Clean body 14–16px, heading 28px. Outline icons, consistent 44px controls, 10px radius, generous 24–32px grouping, no thick outlines, no glass effects or gradients. Different hierarchy from a giant form: a compact preview on the left and a focused current-scene editor on the right. Achieve distinction through interaction and structure, not color changes.

Stable white 242px left navigation with compact true orange logo then 海客视频. Exactly five common menus in groups 创作: 图文视频 (active), 数字人口播; 管理: 我的作品, 发布日历; 设置: API 设置. 账户中心 bottom. Consistent icons, pale yellow selected row and tiny orange marker. No extra menus, analytics, user avatars, counts or marketing banner.

Main header 图文视频, helper 选排版，放入文字与三个画面. Under header one clean short template strip reading 资讯三景 · 9:16 · 9秒 with a small true native layout thumbnail and selected circle; only this actual graphic template exists. Video name 海客科技 · 图文视频 in a restrained editable title field beside/under it, no fake templates.

Workspace is open and spacious, not centered big card. Left region roughly 325px: label 版式参考 and 1080 × 1920. Native dark 9:16 poster only about 248 × 440px, preserve proportions and text layout from attached graphic-news reference: gold 海客科技, white 让创作更简单 / 图文视频工作流, conclusion 三个画面 · 一个观点, navy image zone, dark detail card. Under preview a small note 生成后替换为你的内容, not a live-video player or a real-time-preview claim. Subtle thin vertical separator separates it from the editor, no nesting.

Right editor roughly 710px wide. Header 顶部文字. Instead of three scattered long inputs, use one comfortable compact multiline text area labeled 顶部标题 · 每行一句，共三行, populated 海客科技\n让创作更简单\n图文视频工作流. Small helper 三行标题对应模板顶部. Below an input 结论条 with 三个画面 · 一个观点. All labels above fields, consistent 8px gap, 20px between groups.

Then focus section 三个画面, small helper 每个画面3秒. A clear segmented scene navigation strip 画面1 0–3秒 / 画面2 3–6秒 / 画面3 6–9秒. Active 画面2 uses thin orange underline and pale warm tint; inactive are quiet, visible empty-material indicator tiny outline circle. Only active scene editing area is expanded, allowing users to focus: a medium dashed upload area on left 220 × 160px with upload icon 上传图片 / 视频 and 支持 JPG、PNG、MP4; alongside on right a labeled 详情文字 textarea with three existing lines 统一接入\n一个Key调用能力\n成本和明细可查看. A small inline hint below 当前画面尚未添加素材, no aggressive full-screen alert. No made-up image-generation feature or timeline editor. After this a quiet collapsed secondary row 排版与背景音乐 with sliders/music icon and chevron. This is all existing font/color/background music configuration, no new options invented.

Persistent bottom full-width action bar only within main workspace: supporting 本地合成 · ¥0 and small missing-material hint 还需上传3个画面, secondary outlined 保存草稿, one primary orange 生成图文视频 shown disabled while required media absent. Button padding and hierarchy polished, never giant full-width button or underlined link primary action. Avoid unnecessary cards, model lists, filters, metrics and empty decoration. One focused app screen, visually clear, premium but warm, naturally usable.

Create ONE independent refined Chinese desktop web-app UX design called 场景卡片与侧边设置, for HAIKE 海客科技 video workbench. Target canvas 1440 x 1024, natural app-only desktop viewport, no browser chrome/device frame, no multi-frame montage. Date anchor 2026-10-13. Attachments ground the existing brand and real functions. The old screenshots have bad spacing and huge previews; redesign the interaction, do not recreate those defects. Use actual attached orange-yellow HAIKE 海客科技 company logo without distorting or replacing it.

Consistent design system: white surface, very light warm gray base #f7f7f5, charcoal #191919, muted slate #687180, tiny light-gray separators, bright orange #f64b00 primary actions, pale yellow #fff7c1 selected items. Human readable Chinese body 14–16px, title 28px, h2 18–20px, 44px form controls and buttons, clear labels above fields with 8px gap, 24px grouping. One clean sans font, outline icons, corners 10px. No gradients or glass or heavy black focus borders, no excessive nested cards.

Keep white stable left sidebar 242px wide with compact real brand logo and 海客视频 label. Exactly groups 创作: 图文视频(active), 数字人口播; 管理: 我的作品, 发布日历; 设置: API 设置. Bottom 账户中心. Pale yellow active row with thin orange marker. Navigation remains at the same positions. No user avatars/extra menus/analytics.

Background main workspace shows a DIFFERENT composition from a long vertical form: 图文视频 header with brief subtitle 三个画面，轻松完成图文视频. A compact chosen-template strip 资讯三景 · 9:16 · 9秒, only one real graphic template. A simple name field 海客科技 · 图文视频, three compact labeled headline fields 海客科技 / 让创作更简单 / 图文视频工作流, conclusion 三个画面 · 一个观点. Beneath is a horizontal scene-based editing layout with three coherent standalone objects titled 画面1 0–3秒 / 画面2 3–6秒 / 画面3 6–9秒. Each scene has a dashed image/video upload slot, a 3-line detail textarea and quiet helper. These are actual separate media scenes, so lightweight per-scene surfaces are purposeful. No card-within-card. Background UI should be clearly readable though gently dimmed under an open right-hand modal side panel. No gigantic preview; only small optional native proportional thumbnail using attached native 9:16 composition, no invented scene/video preview.

The HERO INTERACTION is the open right-hand side sheet modal, elegantly sized about 420px wide, inset 16px from top/right/bottom, white with 16px corners and a restrained shadow. A faint overlay dims the rest of app gently about 15%, leaving its context visible. This is not a second separate concept, it is the same app in an actual settings interaction.
Fixed sheet header: 排版与音乐, below small subtitle 资讯三景 · 模板设置; right a quiet 44px X close button with ample hit area. Body has comfortable 24px padding and a vertical readable flow:
Section 文字大小. Two labeled clean dropdown controls 标题字号 value 80px, 详情字号 value 52px. Small helper 只影响模板中文字的大小.
Divider.
Section 模板配色. Two compact rows with true colored square swatch, label, and hex value: 强调色 gold #FFCD3C; 文字板底色 dark #050C16. No enormous native color-picker block. It should look like polished reusable ColorField components.
Divider.
Section 背景音乐. One calm empty upload row with music icon, 未添加音乐, subtle supporting 可选，支持常见音频格式, outlined 上传音乐 button. No fake existing music files or invented sound library.
Small useful note 设置将用于本次视频生成, not intimidating warnings.
Do not fill the panel with unrelated controls; appropriate whitespace.
Fixed panel footer separated by a hairline, with secondary outlined 取消 and primary orange 完成设置 buttons side by side aligned right, 44px tall, stable visible. These are ordinary reversible configuration actions, NOT a new charge or publishing approval.
Main app bottom action bar can remain visible in the background to the left of the sheet, labeled 本地合成 · ¥0, 保存草稿; no new metrics/filters/model chooser. This design should demonstrate excellent modals, button hierarchy, touch target sizes and calmer scene editing, production-ready and strongly recognizable as 海客科技.
